judgement.summary: This is an ISBAR-structured portfolio using five rearranging paper panels to present Aoife’s nursing experience and informatics contributions with careful attribution. Its greatest weakness is that the 3D mostly rearranges labelled evidence, so its explanatory value beyond a well-designed flat document remains modest.
